Papua New Guinea [ a ] (PNG), officially the Independent State of Papua New Guinea , [ 14 ] is an island country in Oceania that comprises the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia , a region of the southwestern Pacific Ocean north of Australia. It has a land border with Indonesia to the west and maritime borders with Australia to the south and the Solomon Islands to the east. Its capital is Port Moresby . The country's 462,840 km 2 (178,700 mi 2 ) includes a large mainland and hundreds of islands.
